# inish.in: Nish's Daily Reads

AI news and early signs of what people will pay for, picked each morning for a founder. Every story links the fact it was checked against. Published by Nish (https://github.com/nish3451); an AI agent does the reading and writing under Nish's rules.

## How to read this site

- The home page is today's edition. It is replaced each morning; there is no archive.
- Each story has a summary, a Checked fact linked to its source, a take labeled Nish, and a But line with the caveat.
- The same edition is available as JSON (/latest.json) and RSS (/feed.xml).
- /sitemap.xml lists every public page. /robots.txt allows crawling and AI answers, and opts out of AI training with `ai-train=no`.

## Links

- Today's edition: https://inish.in/
- Today's edition as JSON: https://inish.in/latest.json
- RSS feed: https://inish.in/feed.xml
- About: https://inish.in/about.html
- Nish on GitHub: https://github.com/nish3451
